DiagramSheet.title: DiagramSheet
DiagramSheet.description: Represents a shared single-line diagram sheet containing transformers, switches, feeder lines, and annotations.

feederCode.description: Feeder code identifier such as FAA-06

transformers.description: List of transformer objects on this diagram sheet

switches.description: List of switch and cutout objects on this diagram sheet

feederPaths.description: List of feeder line path objects on this diagram sheet

annotations.description: List of text annotation labels on this diagram sheet

workspaceId.description: Shared workspace identifier (pea-fang-shared) so all team members access the same diagrams without login

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the sheet was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the sheet was last updated

TransformerDraft.title: TransformerDraft
TransformerDraft.description: Represents a proposed draft to add or edit a transformer by unauthenticated guests or operators, pending admin approval.

actionType.description: Action type: create (add new) or update (edit existing)

targetTransformerId.description: ID of the transformer to edit, if actionType is update

transformerData.description: Proposed transformer properties (peaNo, name, kva, phase, type, poleNo, x, y, etc.)

originalData.description: Snapshot of previous transformer data before editing, for diffing

requesterName.description: Name of the person proposing the draft

requesterContact.description: Phone number, department, or contact info of the requester

requestNotes.description: Reason or notes describing the proposed addition or modification

reviewedBy.description: Email or identifier of the admin who reviewed the draft

reviewedAt.description: Timestamp when the draft was approved or rejected

reviewNote.description: Feedback or explanation from the admin

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the draft was submitted

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the draft was last updated

/sheets/{sheetId}.description: Stores shared diagram sheets for all users under workspaceId pea-fang-shared.

/transformer_drafts/{draftId}.description: Stores proposed transformer additions and edits submitted by guests or operators awaiting admin confirmation.
